chunks: If good comes your way they are vexed, but if calamity befalls you, they say: 'We had taken precautions in advance;' and pleased, turn away.
ai.seo_question: How do the hypocrites react to the Prophet's success and failure according to Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological duality of the hypocrites (al-hunafa), who are driven by envy during the Prophet's success and by vindictive satisfaction during his trials, often citing their own prior predictions to validate their detachment. This reaction underscores the concept of 'taqaddum al-amr' (anticipation of the matter), where they claim their strategic foresight was proven correct, thereby justifying their emotional withdrawal and continued opposition to the Ahl al-Bayt's authority.
